Former Cricketer Claims Virat Kohli Was Bitter About Test Retirement

A former Indian cricketer has claimed that Virat Kohli was bitter about his exit from Test cricket. The former player stated that Kohli felt he was not treated well regarding his departure from the Test format. This sentiment was reportedly expressed by Kohli himself.
